about: Recorded judge answers for the offline demo, keyed by claim text. The replay adapter returns these; it does not judge. Run with --judge openai to have a real model judge instead.

Millbrook's library will stay open until.why: Source 1 states the 9 p.m. weekday opening from March.

citation_spans.span_quote: Evening visits were already the busiest part of the day

evidence_spans.support_span: will open until 9 p.m. on weekdays from March

citation_bears.how_it_bears: The council notice announces the later weekday closing and its one-year funding, which is the claim itself.
The report shows visits concentrated in the evening, which supports the detail but not the new hours.

Longer hours are likely to lift library.why: Source 1 shows full evening rooms; that longer hours lift visits is an inference.

citation_spans.span_quote: the extra hours meet demand rather than create it
Weekend demand is even stronger than evening demand.

evidence_spans.support_span: the reading room was often full after 6 p.m.

citation_bears.how_it_bears: The report records crowded evenings; the brief infers that more evening hours would absorb that demand.
The survey finds little appetite for weekend visits, which cuts against the detail about weekend demand.

Most residents asked for weekend opening.why: Source 1 says 61 percent wanted weekday evenings and only 9 percent weekends.

citation_spans.span_quote: asked for weekend opening rather than evenings

evidence_spans.support_span: Only 9 percent said they would visit more often on weekends.

citation_bears.how_it_bears: The survey reports the opposite preference: evenings, not weekends.

The council plans to close the branch li.why: A judge is never asked about this claim: its only citation does not resolve.
